what: Launch day: the first forecast was issued by hand at 13:58.
Issued at 17:38. Each run re-downloaded the whole year's weather and used up the free Open-Meteo quota, so the noon run timed out. Now only the last two weeks are re-fetched.
Issued at 13:40. The host laptop suspended when its lid closed, so the noon run never started; it was run by hand.
Missed. The host machine ran out of memory during the noon run (the forecast itself used 0.8 GB).
Missed. No run was started at noon; the cause was not recorded.

The host's disk filled up, so the cluster stopped starting jobs and deleted the runtime images. Nov 11 was missed and Nov 12 was not issued on time. A health check now sends an alert before the disk gets that full.
